definitions.explanation: Money that a person, household, or company has borrowed and must repay, especially from a bank. A common term in accounting and personal finance.

examples.japanese: {借入金|かりいれきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧。
⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{借入金|かりいれきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。

⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{借入金|かりいれきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{充|あ}てている→充てる：18707_ateru⟧。
examples.english: We put part of each month's profit toward repaying the loan.

notes:
Refers to the borrowed money itself, viewed from the borrower's side. On a balance sheet it appears as a liability.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {借入金|かりいれきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to repay borrowings
- {借入金|かりいれきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧: outstanding loan balance
- {借入金|かりいれきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らむ→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧: for debt to swell

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{貸付金|かしつけきん}→貸付金：29471_kashitsukekin⟧: loaned money — the same money seen from the lender's side
- ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧: debt — the everyday, more casual word
